event.rollOffTied: Highest roll tied, tied players roll again
event.decisionTimedOut: {{who}} timed out, so "{{ability}}" was decided automatically
event.tripRecovered: {{who}}'s {{athlete}} recovers from a trip and skips this move

cause.BabaYagaTrip: {{target}} and {{source}} stopped on the same space
cause.HugeBabyBlocker: {{target}} was about to stop on {{source}}'s space
cause.LackeyLoyalty: Another racer rolled a 6 this move
cause.InchwormCreep: Another racer rolled a 1 this move
cause.ScoochStep: Another racer just triggered a power
cause.HareHubris: {{source}} started the turn alone in the lead
cause.LovableLoserBonus: {{source}} started the turn alone in last place
cause.LeaptoadJump: {{source}} reached a space with another racer
cause.GunkSlimeModifier: {{source}} is on the board, so {{target}} moved slower
cause.HecklerHeckle: Ended the turn within 1 space of where it started
cause.CheerleaderSupport: {{source}} cheered for last place this turn
cause.PartyPull: {{source}} started their turn and pulled racers in
cause.PartySelfBoost: {{source}} shared a space before this move
cause.MoveDeltaTile: {{target}} landed on space {{from}} and triggered a movement tile
cause.SuckerfishRideIdle: A racer on the space moved, so {{source}} followed
cause.ThirdWheelJoin: {{source}} joined a space with exactly two racers

effect.leaptoadJump: Skips occupied spaces without spending steps

decision.chooseDie: Choose the die value to use
decision.chooseTile: Choose the space to warp to
decision.chooseCopy: Choose the racer power to copy

prompt.GeniusPrediction: Predict the next die value. Guess right for an extra turn.
prompt.MastermindPredict: Predict which other racer will finish first.
prompt.FlipFlopSwap: Swap spaces with a racer, skipping your normal move this turn. You can also decline.
prompt.HypnotistWarp: Warp another racer to your space. You can also decline.
prompt.DuelistDuel: Duel a racer on your space. Both roll; the higher roll moves 2, and the challenger wins ties. You can also decline.
prompt.ThirdWheelJoin: Warp to a space holding exactly two racers. You can also decline.
prompt.CopyLead: The lead is tied. Choose which racer to copy.
prompt.CheerleaderSupport: Move every racer in last place 2 spaces, then move yourself 1?
prompt.RocketScientistBoost: Add this die's value to your move again? You will trip afterwards.
prompt.DicemongerDeal: Reroll? Borrowing another racer's Dicey Deals moves them 1 space.
prompt.MagicalReroll: Reroll? Twice per turn at most.
prompt.LongLegs: Skip the main-move die and move 5 spaces instead? Those spaces still count as your main move.
